meta_data.base_class: Identify specific animals based on recordings of <animal classes> - refers to zoological taxonomic classes of animals.

audio_clip.description: Base64 encoded audio clip string of the <class> sound.

time_of_day.description: Time of day when the sound was recorded. Should be one of the following options: 'Dawn', 'Morning', 'Noon', 'Afternoon', 'Evening', 'Night'.

latitude.description: Latitude of the location where the <class> sound was recorded.

longitude.description: Longitude of the location where the <class> sound was recorded.

sensitivity.description: Sensitivity level of the recognition process, ranging from 1 (low) to 10 (high).

filter_background_noise.description: Whether to filter out background noise from the audio clip.

weather_conditions.description: Weather conditions at the time of recording the <class> sound. Should be one of the following options: 'Sunny', 'Cloudy', 'Rainy', 'Snowy', 'Windy', 'Foggy', 'Stormy'.

duration.description: Duration of the audio clip in seconds. Indicates how long the <class> sound was recorded for, having a minimum value of 1 second.

device_used.description: Type of device used for recording the <class> sound. Should be one of the following options: 'Smartphone', 'Microphone', 'Digital Recorder', 'Other'.

proximity_to_subject.description: Estimated proximity to the <class> subject when the sound was recorded. Options include 'Very Close', 'Moderate', 'Distant'.
